processes.name: inference gateway

processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and accesses model artifacts and customer features.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The source says artifact integrity is not believed to be verified: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store's customer account-age and spend-band records are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer.

assumptions.assumption: The inference log is confidential because it contains raw prompts supplied by users.
assumptions.basis: The log contains every request and response, including raw prompts that may contain whatever users typed.

assumptions.assumption: The model registry bucket's model artifacts are confidential business data.
assumptions.basis: The bucket contains model artifacts used by the hosted inference service.
